lede: The big one this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where a first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements is on the table — rules that directly shape how buildings go up in this box canyon, and worth paying close attention to. Council will also hold a second work session on the Telluride Energy initiative, and the Housing Authority meets the same evening to seat the new Resident Advisory Committee and conduct a lottery drawing from tenant applicants across five Town properties. The rest of the week brings the BOCC, a liquor licensing slate heavy with summer events, and Ouray County quietly reworking its land-use definitions — the kind of foundational language that shapes everything downstream.
